blueprint.name: Deploying F5 License Proxy as an IBM Cloud VSI
blueprint.description: Stand up the F5 License Proxy (FLP) as a standalone IBM Cloud VSI appliance in an existing VPC — no cluster required. BNK installs in other clusters license through it privately over the VPC or a Transit Gateway, so only this appliance needs egress to F5.

outcomes: F5 License Proxy running as a podman pod on an IBM Cloud VSI
Licensing endpoint + root CA published as outputs for consuming clusters
Optional flp-status web UI on an operator floating IP

prerequisites.description: An IBM Cloud credential template on the project. The API key provisions the VSI; region and resource group inherit from it.
An existing IBM Cloud VPC to deploy the appliance into, reachable by the consuming cluster (same VPC, peered, or over a Transit Gateway). The proxy is the only component that needs egress to F5.
The F5 FAR auth tarball and subscription JWT must already be in IBM COS (cos_instance/cos_bucket). The runner reads them from COS — project-local file secrets are not used.

input_summary.label: Deploys
input_summary.value: One VSI appliance (default bx2-4x16, 100 GB boot) running the f5-license-proxy stack — the proxy, Vault and PostgreSQL — as a systemd-managed podman pod.

input_summary.label: Licensing reach
input_summary.value: :8443 is gated to the RFC-1918 ranges by default, because the consuming cluster reaches the proxy privately. The operator floating IP is a management path, not the CWC endpoint.

input_summary.label: Consuming a proxy
input_summary.value: Feed this deployment's external_endpoint + root_ca_b64 outputs into the consuming workspace's bnk.flp.external block.

required.name: prefix
required.label: Resource prefix
required.description: Prefix for the appliance's resource names (e.g. acme-flp).

required.name: region
required.label: IBM Cloud region
required.description: Region the FLP VSI is created in. Inherits from the selected credential template.

required.name: resource_group
required.label: Resource group
required.description: IBM Cloud resource group. Inherits from the selected credential template.

required.name: flp_vsi_vpc
required.label: Existing VPC (ID)
required.description: ID of the existing VPC to deploy the appliance into. Naming a VPC here is what makes this a standalone, cluster-less appliance.

required.name: cos_bucket
required.label: COS bucket
required.description: COS bucket holding the FAR supply chain. Blank = bnk-artifacts.

optional.name: flp_vsi_zone
optional.label: Zone
optional.description: Zone for the VSI (e.g. us-south-1). Blank = the region's first zone.

optional.name: flp_vsi_profile
optional.label: VSI profile
optional.description: IBM Cloud instance profile. Blank = bx2-4x16, which meets the FLP's 4 vCPU / 8 GB minimum.

optional.name: flp_vsi_ssh_key
optional.label: SSH key name
optional.description: Name of an existing IBM Cloud VPC SSH key to attach, so an operator can inspect or recover the appliance. Blank = no SSH access.

optional.name: flp_vsi_boot_size_gb
optional.label: Boot volume (GB)
optional.description: Boot volume size. Blank = 100, which clears the FLP's >80 GB requirement.

optional.name: flp_vsi_floating_ip
optional.label: Attach an operator floating IP
optional.description: On = attach a floating IP so `flp status` and the :80 web UI work from outside the VPC. It is a management path only — the consuming cluster always reaches the proxy privately.

optional.name: flp_vsi_reach
optional.label: CWC reach
optional.description: Address the consuming cluster's CWC dials: private (default, the VSI's VPC IP) or floating.

optional.name: flp_management_allowed_cidrs
optional.label: Management allowed CIDRs
optional.description: Comma-separated CIDRs permitted to reach the :80 status UI. Blank = 0.0.0.0/0 — the page is read-only and carries no secrets.

optional.name: flp_licensing_allowed_cidrs
optional.label: Licensing allowed CIDRs
optional.description: Comma-separated CIDRs permitted to reach the :8443 proxy and :22. Blank = the RFC-1918 private ranges.

optional.name: flp_status_image
optional.label: flp-status image
optional.description: Image for the flp-status web UI, e.g. harbor.example.com/bnk-status/flp-status:v1. Blank = no status UI (the proxy still serves :8443).

optional.name: flp_status_registry_host
optional.label: Status image registry host
optional.description: Registry host serving the status image. Only needed when it is a private or self-signed mirror.

optional.name: flp_status_registry_ca_b64
optional.label: Status registry CA (base64)
optional.description: Base64 CA for that registry, dropped into the VSI's certs.d so the status image pull is trusted. Already base64 — it is stored verbatim.

optional.name: manifest_version
optional.label: BNK manifest version
optional.description: Manifest release the FLP chart set is resolved from. Blank = the roksbnkctl default.

optional.name: cos_instance
optional.label: COS instance
optional.description: COS instance holding the FAR supply chain, used only when the local-file paths are cleared. Blank = bnk-supply-chain.

optional.name: cos_region
optional.label: COS region
optional.description: Region of that bucket. Blank = us-south.

optional.name: far_auth_file
optional.label: FAR auth object name
optional.description: Object name of the FAR auth tarball in the bucket. Blank = f5-far-auth-key.tgz.

optional.name: subscription_jwt_file
optional.label: Subscription JWT object name
optional.description: Object name of the subscription JWT in the bucket. Blank = subscription.jwt.

optional.name: flp_namespace
optional.label: FLP namespace
optional.description: Kubernetes namespace the F5 License Proxy client resources go into. Blank keeps the default the subscription JWT implies.

optional.name: ibmcloud_api_key
optional.label: IBM Cloud API key
optional.description: Resolved from the project's credential template when the project is created. Not entered by hand.

modules.name: roksbnkctl FLP (VSI)
modules.description: roksbnkctl flp up in vsi mode — a standalone F5 License Proxy appliance in an existing VPC.
